About Izzy

Short captions. Long impression.

Izzy Mansouri is a fashion, beauty and lifestyle creator based in Türkiye, followed by nearly a million people on Instagram. Her feed moves between styled shoots, beauty close-ups and travel frames — always polished, always personal.

She lets the frames speak: a look, a place, a mood — and a line of hers underneath it all.

“Real beauty is Behaviour.”
